prerequisites: Bronze pickaxe and hammer permitted as setup

steps.action: Walk to and left-click a copper rock
steps.expected: Copper ore earned once with mining animation, sound, XP, depletion, and message

steps.action: Walk to and left-click a tin rock
steps.expected: Tin ore earned once with mining feedback

steps.action: Walk to and left-click the furnace
steps.expected: One copper and one tin are consumed; one bronze bar is earned with smelting feedback

steps.action: Walk to and left-click the anvil
steps.expected: One bronze bar is consumed; one Bronze dagger is earned with smithing feedback

steps.action: Equip the Bronze dagger from inventory
steps.expected: Dagger appears in equipment and on the player without duplication
